mapper.select: SELECT id,title,created_at,updated_at FROM conversation WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{user} AND NOT deleted FOR UPDATE

INSERT INTO chat_message(conversation_id,user_id,role,content,request_id,trace_id,status,knowledge_base_ids,expires_at) VALUES (#{conversation},#{user},#{role},#{content},#{request},#{trace},#{status},CAST(#{scope} AS jsonb), clock_timestamp()+#{timeoutMs}*interval '1 millisecond') RETURNING id
SELECT count(*) FROM conversation WHERE user_id=#{user} AND NOT deleted
SELECT id,title,created_at,updated_at FROM conversation WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{user} AND NOT deleted

SELECT COALESCE(c.evidence_content,c.snippet) AS content,c.source_metadata::text AS metadata_json, v.source_format AS format FROM message_citation c JOIN chat_message m ON m.id=c.message_id JOIN conversation conv ON conv.id=m.conversation_id AND conv.user_id=#{user} AND NOT conv.deleted JOIN document_version v ON v.document_id=c.document_id AND v.version_no=c.document_version WHERE m.id=#{message} AND conv.id=#{conversation} AND c.citation_id=#{citation}
mapper.update: UPDATE conversation SET deleted=true WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{user} AND NOT deleted
mapper.select: INSERT INTO conversation(user_id,title) VALUES (#{user},#{title}) RETURNING id,title,created_at,updated_at
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM chat_message WHERE conversation_id=#{id} AND role='ASSISTANT' AND status='GENERATING')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message_citation(message_id,citation_id,chunk_id,document_id,document_version,document_name, page_number,chapter,section,line_start,line_end,snippet,tables,preview) VALUES (#{message},#{c.citationId},#{c.chunkId},#{c.documentId},#{c.documentVersion},#{c.documentName}, #{c.page},#{c.chapter},#{c.section},#{c.lineStart},#{c.lineEnd},#{c.snippet},CAST(#{tables} AS jsonb),CAST(#{preview} AS jsonb)) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT c.citation_id,c.document_id,c.document_version,c.document_name,c.page_number AS page,c.chapter,c.section, c.line_start,c.line_end,c.chunk_id,c.snippet,c.tables::text AS tables_json,c.preview::text AS preview_json, parent.metadata::text AS fallback_metadata_json FROM message_citation c LEFT JOIN document_chunk parent ON jsonb_array_length(c.preview)=0 AND jsonb_array_length(c.tables)=0 AND parent.id=c.chunk_id AND parent.document_id=c.document_id AND parent.document_version=c.document_version AND parent.chunk_type='PARENT' AND left(parent.content,length(c.snippet))=c.snippet WHERE c.message_id=#{id} ORDER BY c.id
mapper.update: WITH expired AS ( UPDATE chat_message SET status='FAILED',error_code='RAG_504_TIMEOUT' WHERE conversation_id=#{id} AND role='ASSISTANT' AND status='GENERATING' AND expires_at<=clock_timestamp() RETURNING request_id ) UPDATE rag_request_trace SET status='FAILED',reason_code='RAG_504_TIMEOUT', latency_ms=greatest(0,extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()-created_at)*1000)::bigint WHERE status='RUNNING' AND request_id IN (SELECT request_id FROM expired)
mapper.select: SELECT m.role,m.content FROM chat_message m JOIN conversation c ON c.id=m.conversation_id AND c.user_id=#{user} AND NOT c.deleted WHERE m.conversation_id=#{conversation} AND m.user_id=#{user} AND m.request_id<>#{request} AND m.status='COMPLETED' AND m.knowledge_base_ids <@ CAST(#{scope} AS jsonb) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM chat_message a WHERE a.request_id=m.request_id AND a.role='ASSISTANT' AND a.status='COMPLETED') ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT user_id FROM chat_message WHERE request_id=#{request} AND role='ASSISTANT'
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_message SET confidence_level=#{confidence},faithfulness_status=#{status}, verification_details=CAST(#{details} AS jsonb),retrieval_mode=#{route},retrieval_trace=CAST(#{trace} AS jsonb) WHERE id=#{id}

WITH cancelled AS ( UPDATE chat_message SET status='CANCELLED' WHERE request_id=#{request} AND role='ASSISTANT' AND status='GENERATING' RETURNING request_id ) UPDATE rag_request_trace SET status='CANCELLED',reason_code='CANCELLED', latency_ms=greatest(0,extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()-created_at)*1000)::bigint WHERE status='RUNNING' AND request_id IN (SELECT request_id FROM cancelled)
